name: Wooden Standing Towel Rack 1
description: Elegant freestanding wooden towel rack with multiple hanging bars and hooks. Ideal for bathrooms, bedrooms or laundry areas.
details: This freestanding wooden towel rack offers practical and stylish storage for towels and clothes. Perfect for organising towels in bathrooms, bedrooms or utility spaces in Sri Lankan homes.
